title: SB 26-189 - Automated Decision-Making Technology (Colorado)
notes: Primary official state bill page (enacted, signed May 14, 2026, Chapter 131). Cited for the Colorado revised AI/ADMT law under Social (US state preemption context).
claims: SB 26-189 repeals and reenacts SB 24-205 (2024) with new ADMT requirements
Developer obligations effective January 1, 2027: technical documentation to deployers, material-update notice, 3-year record retention
Consumer notice at point of interaction; plain-language description within 30 days of adverse-outcome decision; AG rules by Jan 1, 2027
Consumer rights: data access/correction, meaningful human review and reconsideration after adverse outcome
Enforced via Colorado Consumer Protection Act; 60-day cure notice before actions prior to Jan 1, 2030; no new private right of action
